KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

2. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mato
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

5. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. zito
   D. pana

6. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.

7. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

8. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain uliopita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Lishe Bora and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma: Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
